content.value_statement: Teams often get stuck copying DNS records and confirming domain verification. This skill guides Mailtrap sending domain setup, DNS provider steps, propagation checks, and compliance follow-up.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to add a root domain or exact sending subdomain.
Guides users to copy every Mailtrap DNS record into the active DNS zone.
Lists Mailtrap Sending Domains API endpoints for listing, fetching, and creating domains.
Points to provider guides for Cloudflare, Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Squarespace, GoDaddy, Namecheap, and DigitalOcean.
Advises DNS propagation checks with dig, nslookup, or public lookup tools.
Highlights compliance completion and DNS-only settings for proxied DNS records.
limitations: Does not perform DNS changes or Mailtrap API calls by itself.
Does not replace live DNS records shown in the Mailtrap UI.
Requires domain access and valid Mailtrap credentials for API automation.
Provider instructions may need adjustment for custom DNS control panels.

use_cases.title: Launch a new sending domain
use_cases.description: Follow Mailtrap UI and DNS provider steps to add records and verify the domain before production sending.

use_cases.title: Automate domain provisioning
use_cases.description: Use the documented API workflow to fetch Mailtrap records and publish them through a DNS provider API.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot pending verification
use_cases.description: Check DNS propagation, exact hostnames, and proxy settings when Mailtrap does not verify records.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new sending domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up a Mailtrap sending domain for example.com. List the DNS and verification steps I should follow.

prompt_templates.title: Follow a provider guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding Mailtrap sending domain records at Cloudflare. Include checks for proxied records and propagation.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose pending verification
prompt_templates.scenario: Troubleshooting a domain that does not verify.
prompt_templates.prompt: Mailtrap still shows my sending domain as pending. Help me compare expected records, DNS visibility, hostname choice, and compliance status.

prompt_templates.title: Design automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced API and DNS provider workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an automated workflow for Mailtrap sending domain provisioning with API retrieval, DNS provider updates, polling, and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: I need to verify notifications.example.com in Mailtrap.
output: Add notifications.example.com as the exact sending domain.
Copy every DNS record shown by Mailtrap into the active DNS zone.
Wait for propagation, verify public DNS visibility, then click Verify in Mailtrap.
Complete the compliance step if Mailtrap requests it.

output_examples.input: Mailtrap verification is pending and my DNS uses Cloudflare.
output: Confirm each record name and value matches Mailtrap exactly.
Set verification records to DNS-only unless Mailtrap documentation allows proxying.
Use a DNS lookup to confirm public visibility before retrying verification.

output_examples.input: I want to automate setup for many customer domains.
output: Create each sending domain through the Mailtrap API.
Read the returned DNS records and publish them through the DNS provider API.
Poll Mailtrap status after DNS propagation and report records that remain unverified.

best_practices: Add the exact From hostname as the sending domain.
Copy every Mailtrap DNS record exactly from the UI or API.
Keep verification records DNS-only when a provider supports proxying.
anti_patterns: Adding only the root domain when email sends from a subdomain.
Cherry-picking DNS records instead of publishing the complete set.
Proxying verification records unless Mailtrap documentation explicitly allows it.

faq.question: Do I need to verify a domain before sending?
faq.answer: Yes. Mailtrap requires the sending domain to be verified before live sending from that domain.

faq.question: Can I verify a subdomain instead of the root domain?
faq.answer: Yes. Add the exact hostname used in the From address, such as notifications.example.com.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It explains domain setup and verification. It does not send messages or call Mailtrap by itself.

faq.question: What should I check when verification stays pending?
faq.answer: Check record names, values, public DNS visibility, propagation timing, proxy settings, and Mailtrap compliance status.

faq.question: Can this setup be automated?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes Mailtrap API endpoints and DNS provider API usage for automation workflows.

faq.question: Which DNS providers are referenced?
faq.answer: It references Cloudflare, AWS Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Squarespace, GoDaddy, Namecheap, and DigitalOcean.
